title: Zoetrope
description: The Victorian animation drum, on a wooden stand with a spindle and brass rims. A slotted cylinder spins, the animation strip is painted around the inside wall (you can see it ghosted across the back), and through the near slits it springs to life a frame at a time — the classic Muybridge galloping horse, a walk cycle, a runner, a flapping bird, a leaping fish, a bouncing ball, a blooming flower or a spinning star. Spin it up until the slit strobe locks and the figure animates; slow it and the sequence smears. Subject, frame count, spin speed, slit width, lamp glow and palette are live and mappable.
